card.name: Science news attributions to researchers
card.fires_on: Small words such as a, an, at, 's and 'and' in science press-release text, just before the researchers, institution or journal that did the study is named.

modes.label: Article before research team
modes.description: 'A' or 'an' that opens or introduces a team of scientists or a study.
modes.example: SYRACUSE, N.Y. —<< A>> team of investigators, led by Peter D

modes.label: Linking word before institution
modes.description: A linking word right before a university, lab or partner institution is named.
modes.example: developed<< at>> the Department of Energy's Pacific Northwest National

modes.label: Inside the study source
modes.description: Small words in the phrase naming the journal or issue where the study was published.
modes.example: according to a study published in this month<<'s>> issue of Journal of Power Sources

card.plain: It fires on small words in university science news just before the researchers or institution behind a study are named.
